environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in us-east-1, running behind an ALB with no WAF attached. The application listens on port 8080 and the ALB forwards traffic directly. The EC2 instance has an IAM role with S3 read access and the instance metadata service (IMDSv1) is enabled. Security groups allow inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to the ALB, and ALB to EC2 on 8080. No network ACLs restrict outbound from the instance.

config.network: ALB -> EC2:8080, no WAF, no egress restrictions
